opening.argument: The video presents Polkadot price analysis with defined trading levels, not a promised return. It discusses an accumulation range and makes the upside case conditional on support holding and a breakout with volume; it also describes a downside case in which price could retest two dollars or lower. The $4.99 DeFi guide is offered as an educational purchase about staking and yield farming. Although the guide mentions passive income strategies, the video acknowledges uncertainty and requires technical confirmation rather than guaranteeing earnings. Nothing in the supplied material establishes deceptive checkout behavior.
